structural_correspondence: The PS2 and Golden complete HELP task constructors replace any old same-name task, allocate92->216B of owned work, install exactly three slot callbacks, and register a priority15 child. Their dispatchers test active bit1 for exactly three entries, invoke each callback with manager base and selected entry, clear active bit on nonzero completion, and return0. Original MIPS confirms24B entry stride/callback offsets14,2c,44; ordinary Golden dispatcher1327e0 uses56B stride and callback offsets20,58,90. This independently establishes a three-entry help-controller identity, not just equal spelling or a module label. Lookup/arm and gameplay prompt writers are additional old users of this same manager.

ps2_roles.0x0024f080: Lookup/arm selected entry: active bit, counters/state reset and display mode2/4.
ps2_roles.0x0024f790: Fishing aim looks up entry1, writes direction and marks its prompt feedback flag.
ps2_roles.0x00250120: Replace HELP manager and create3-entry task; the separate DATA task initialization is context only.

paired_dispatchers.rule: On flagbit0 invoke callback(base,entry); if result!=0 clearbit0; after all3 return0. Golden unrolls the loop.

constructor_delta.parent_change: Golden13c7d0 is primary-task lookup only. Old285af0 also tried evtEdit. No behavioral equality is claimed for the fallback or extra work fields.

query_evidence: All51 materialized Golden HELP string reference PCs are recorded below. Six envelopes cover constructor/replacement, new staged setup, help display callbacks and expanded fishing-phase/prompt logic. These extra Golden users are not asserted one-to-one matches for PS2 functions. In particular12e780 is a time-gated new setup, not the generic old arm API; its3/5 low-bit display modes and counter resets provide context, not full equivalence.
